needs.text: Whether the allowed record supports the Delhi DRC Act s14(1)(b) ground of subletting, assignment, or other parting with possession without the landlord's written consent, while preserving the rival licence/control account and the statutory date threshold.

Whether the Petitioner's asserted 1944 subtenancy falls within the pre-9 June 1952 and pre-Act treatment of subletting, including what lawfulness and occupation-at-commencement facts remain unresolved.
Whether the Petitioner can invoke DRC Act ss17-18 protection based on the 2001 letters or other writings, given the rival positions on written consent, prescribed notice, and landlord knowledge.
Whether United India Insurance's occupation was a subtenancy or only a licence/permissive use, including the relevance of exclusive or legal possession, retained control, and compensation.
Whether any independent occupancy or direct-tenancy protection survives after Canara Bank accepted the impugned order and vacated, given the Petitioner's asserted s18 protection.

What effect, at the present Article 227 stage, should be given to the newly produced 2001 letters and the asserted s18 theory that respondents say was not pleaded or raised below, while a prior Coordinate Bench judgment concerned the other sub-tenants.
